title: 2013 – Opening of Mobility Experience Centre at Cyberport
author: hkwtia
plainText: With the support of Cyberport, WDC is renovated as Mobility Experience Centre (MEC) in 2013. The establishment of MEC aims to provide a space for public to experience advanced mobile devices, and also highlights the illustrious accomplishments Hong Kong has achieved in mobile technology. Outstanding and award-winning applications and wireless technology-related products developed by local IT companies are showcasing in the Centre.
